parsed.name: WebSocket通信器
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件通信组件，通过 WebSocket 与实验相关的软件服务或仪器控制端点建立连接，发送命令并接收文本或二进制响应，可用于远程控制、数据交换以及二进制消息回调处理。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software communication component that connects to experiment-related software services or instrument control endpoints over WebSocket, sends commands, and receives text or binary responses, and supports remote control, data exchange, and binary message callback handling.

actions.description: 打开 WebSocket 连接并开始监听传入的二进制消息。
actions.description_en: Open the WebSocket connection and start listening for incoming binary messages.

actions.description: 通过 WebSocket 向服务器发送命令。
actions.description_en: Send a command to the server over WebSocket.

actions.description: 检查 WebSocket 连接是否处于打开状态。
actions.description_en: Check whether the WebSocket connection is open.

actions.description: 获取下一条文本或常规响应消息。
actions.description_en: Fetch the next text or regular response message.

actions.description: 获取下一条二进制响应消息。
actions.description_en: Fetch the next binary response message.

actions.description: 注册二进制消息回调函数，使其在收到每条二进制消息时被调用。
actions.description_en: Register a binary message callback to be invoked for each incoming binary message.

actions.description: 发送命令并在限定超时时间内等待对应响应。
actions.description_en: Send a command and wait for the corresponding response within a timeout.
